The heater now holds its state inside a half-degree band either side of the target, and replaying last night's log gives 2 relay switches instead of 12.

The half degree is `HYSTERESIS_C = 0.5`, right under `TARGET_C` in `greenhouse.py`. The heater comes on at or below 19.5°C, goes off at or above 20.5°C, and otherwise stays as it was. On last night's log that means one on at 04:26 (19.3°C) and one off at 04:40 (20.6°C).

Two things to be aware of:

- **Pi controller:** `heater_on` now takes the current relay state as a second argument. Only this replay script is in the folder, so if the controller on the Pi has its own copy of the decision or calls `heater_on` itself, it needs the same change before the real relay stops chattering.
- **Start-up:** the relay starts off, so if the first reading is inside the band (say 19.8°C) the heater stays off until the temperature drops to 19.5°C.
